learning_outcomes.text: Understand Magnetic materials and Magnetic circuits.
Understand DC and AC electromagnets.
Perform 3-phase power measurement.
Understand Transformer, principle, theory, equivalent circuit, phasor diagram, instrument transformer design.
Perform Transformer: Open-circuit test, Short-circuit test; understand drop of voltage by loading.
Understand 3-phase transformer, hour angle. Special transformers.
Understand Asynchronous motor, principle, construction, operating parameters.
Understand As. Motor - theory, equivalent circuit, losses - subdivision.
Understand Speed-torque characteristic. Circle diagram. Single-phase as. motor.
Understand Asynchronous motor - starting, speed control.
Understand Synchronous machine, generator, motor, reluctance and stepper motors.
Understand DC-machines, principle, theory, equivalent circuit, fundamental equations.
Understand DC - separately excited; (- shunt; - series) motor, speed - torque characteristic, starting.
Understand Ward-Leonard system, speed controlling of DC-motors, Single-phase commutator motor.
Understand Low-voltage instruments, fuses, breakers, residual current devices.
Understand Low-voltage power network.
Repetition of safety work rules.
Calculations: 3-phase AC-circuits and 3-phase power. Measuring Instruments.
Perform 3-phase power measurement: 3 Wattmeter method; artificial connections - 1 W-method, 2 W- (Aron) method; reactive power and power factor; non-harmonic waveforms measurement.
Perform Magnetic circuits measurement, electromagnet characteristic measurement, magnetic circuit calculation.
Understand Power semiconductors, steady-state characteristics, cooling. Perform Cooling calculation and verification.
Perform 1-phase transformer: Open-circuit test, Short-circuit test; loading.
